name: Roy Wright
headline: ERP Consultant - Dynamics GP / 365 BC (Business Central)
about:
A Microsoft Dynamics Certified Professional – Working with Dynamics GP since 2000.

Experience of implementing Dynamics GP into a range of different industries. I have built strong working relationships with customers and gained their trust in supplying them with the right solution for their business process. I have a strong technical background which aids me in designing and specifying solutions around the GP application modules to fulfill the customer’s requirements. 

Experience of working with 3rd Party WMS suppliers to integrate Dynamics GP with their WMS solutions.

A specialist in designing and enhancing Dynamics GP functionality using a combination of Dexterity, Extender, Smartlist Builder, VBA, SQL and Excel.

Experience of integrating with Dynamics GP using a range of tools (SSIS, SQL Procedures & EConnect procedures).

Microsoft Certifications:
Microsoft Dynamics GP 2013 Financials (Exam MB3-701)
Microsoft Dynamics GP 2010 Financials (Exam MB3-859)
Microsoft SQL Server 2008, Business Intelligence Development and Maintenance (Exam 070-448)
Great Plains 8.0 Modifier with VBA
